normal.name: SethTheHex
normal.text: I really can't feel sorry for slamming this when there's devs sacrificing everything for YEARS to make games like Stardew and Dwarf Fortress, yet you think 2 months of development on something you've always "loved doing" will produce a good result?

normal.name: American Century of BOO-miliation
normal.text: Welcome to Stardew Valley! This is Pierre's, the town's biggest and whiniest supplier of seeds, baking goods, and gardening needs, as well as the sole provider of courtship gifts and the only magistrate who can solemnize a marriage. Across town? The evil monopolist.

normal.name: Gamma
normal.text: Another thing about Village in the Shade that I will give it credit for, the farming sim loop feels inspired by Harvest Moon DS and I am here for that, however I cant help but feel like the core farming gameplay misses the point? Idk I need to play more of it.
